national_law.name: NIS-2-Umsetzungs- und Cybersicherheitsstaerkungsgesetz
national_law.formal_citation: Gesetz zur Umsetzung der NIS-2-Richtlinie und zur Regelung wesentlicher Grundzuege des Informationssicherheitsmanagements in der Bundesverwaltung
national_law.primary_amended_law: BSI-Gesetz (BSIG) - Act on the Federal Office for Information Security
national_law.entry_into_force_note: Day after publication; no general transitional period

legislative_history.event: First reference draft (Referentenentwurf) published by BMI
EU transposition deadline passed without enactment
Coalition collapse; Bundestag dissolution; bill lapsed (Diskontinuitaetsprinzip)

competent_authority.name: Bundesamt fuer Sicherheit in der Informationstechnik
competent_authority.role: National competent authority, CSIRT, Federal CISO, supervisory authority for private entities, defines minimum security requirements for federal authorities

incident_reporting.detailed_notification: 72 hours - detailed information including root-cause analysis
incident_reporting.final_report: 1 month - final report with mitigation measures and preventive steps

essential_entities.maximum: EUR 10,000,000 or 2% of worldwide annual turnover, whichever is higher

important_entities.maximum: EUR 7,000,000 or 1.4% of worldwide annual turnover, whichever is higher

compliance_deadlines.compliance_obligations: Immediate from entry into force (no general transitional period)

management_liability.description: Expressly codifies responsibility at management level. Active monitoring of security measure implementation required. Training at least every 3 years with detailed documentation. Personal liability for key security decisions that cannot be fully delegated.

supply_chain_requirements.description: Supply chain oversight and comprehensive documentation are integral components of Section 30 requirements

core_compliance.requirement: Appropriate, effective, and proportionate technical and organizational measures establishing a systematically managed ISMS focusing on availability, integrity, and confidentiality of IT systems

sources.title: Greenberg Traurig - NIS2 in Germany: The New BSI Act
Reed Smith - Finally: Germany enacts its NIS2 law
Bird & Bird - German Bundestag passes German NIS 2 Implementation Act
Morrison Foerster - Flipping the NIS2 Switch

notes: Germany missed original Oct 2024 deadline due to coalition collapse and snap elections
The bill had to be reintroduced after the February 2025 federal elections
No general transitional period - obligations apply immediately from entry into force
ELSTER digital certificates required for corporate account (MUK) setup
Entities choose own security framework if sector-specific regulations don't apply
